title: feat(console): eight console pages draw the console page header in place of a hand-made h1 (objectui#12553)
body:
Fixes #12553
Clause-②: no — the pages consume the existing `ConsolePageHeader` export of `@object-ui/app-shell`; no export, prop, type member or i18n key is added or removed.

## What changes

Eight console pages draw the console page header that an object list, a dashboard and the Approvals Inbox draw (PR objectui#12552), in place of their own h1, icon and subtitle line: an icon chip where the page drew an icon, the title, the subtitle beside the title from `sm` up, and the page's header-row actions, in one row across the page above its padded body. Each page is wrapped the way the inbox was: the header sits above the body, the body keeps its own padding and max-width, and the body is not re-indented, so each page's diff stays at its header block.

| Page | File (under `apps/console/src/pages/`) | Chip icon | Header actions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flow Runs | `developer/FlowRunsPage.tsx` | Workflow | none |
| Integrations & APIs | `developer/IntegrationsPage.tsx` | Plug | none |
| Audit Log | `system/AuditLogPage.tsx` | ScrollText | Refresh |
| AI Approvals | `system/AiPendingActionsPage.tsx` | none (the page drew none) | none |
| Applications | `system/AppManagementPage.tsx` | none (the page drew none) | New App |
| Profile | `system/ProfilePage.tsx` | none (the page drew none) | none |
| Settings hub | `settings/SettingsHub.tsx` | Settings | none |
| Settings namespace page | `settings/SettingsView.tsx` | the manifest's icon, when it names one | none |

- **Texts unchanged.** Every title, subtitle and action keeps its literal or its i18n key, and its handler. No i18n key and no `ConsolePageHeader` prop is added. The icons drop their old size and colour classes (`text-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`), as the inbox's did: the chip sizes and tints its icon.
- **Settings namespace page.** The Beta badge rides in the title node beside the name, the shape `ObjectView` and `ObjectDataPage` already use for their badge in this same header. The manifest's description is the subtitle. Back to settings stays at the top of the page body, where it sat above the old heading; it was never a header-row action.
- **Phone.** Below `sm` each page keeps a header (icon, title and actions in one row) and the header hides its subtitle there, as on the inbox. No page has more than one header action, so none needed reshaping. Applications' New App, which stacked under the title on a phone, now sits in the row.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/12553-console-page-headers.md`, `@object-ui/console` patch.

## Measured before building

- **The census.** The ruled `git grep` for an h1 opening tag over `apps/console/src/pages/**/*.tsx` at base `baab2d6ed0` lists the eight pages above (plus `AppManagementPage.i18n.test.tsx`, which quotes one in a comment). That pathspec matches no file that sits directly in `pages/`: git's default pathspec needs a slash after `pages/` before `**/` can match, so `DocsIndex.tsx`, `BookPage.tsx`, `DocPage.tsx`, `DocsSlug.tsx` and `SharedRecordPage.tsx` are outside it. The same grep over the directory (`-- apps/console/src/pages/`) lists those five too. No page was added since the claim.
- **DocsIndex.** The claim reads that `DocsIndex.tsx` draws no h1 at `baab2d6ed0`. It does: its ready state draws "Documentation" as an h1 in a header block, and its load-error state draws "Failed to load documentation". The claim's reading came from the pathspec above. It is still left out, for the reason A1 names: `/docs` is a top-level route that `App.tsx` mounts, not `AppContent`, and the page renders inside `DocShell`, which draws its own sticky "Documentation" bar; the docs portal deliberately keeps the console app shell out (ADR-0046, per `DocShell`'s docblock). The h1s in `BookPage`, `DocPage` and `DocsSlug` are error and empty states inside `DocShell`. `SharedRecordPage` is the public share-link page at `/s/TOKEN`, outside `AppContent`; its headers name a shared conversation or record, not a console page.
- **A1, measured.** All eight pages are routes in `AppContent`'s `systemRoutes` (`/apps/APP/system/...` and `/apps/APP/developer/...`). Five are also component refs (`developer:flow-runs`, `developer:integrations`, `audit:log`, `ai:approvals`, `account:profile_card`). `ComponentNavView` renders a registered component bare, with no header of its own, so no host draws a second header.
- **A2, measured.** `SettingsHub` (`system/settings`) and `SettingsView` (`system/settings/:namespace`) are sibling routes; the view is never rendered under the hub. Each one's h1 names its page, so both are page headers and both convert. The hub's category h2s stay section headings in its body.

## Tests

- **Pins, one per converted page** (`*.pageHeader-12553.test.tsx`), each through the real page and the real `ConsolePageHeader`; only the adapter, metadata and transport are stubbed. Each pins that `page-header` holds the page's only h1 with its title; that the subtitle is a P in the title's row; that the chip holds an icon, or, on a page that drew none, that there is no icon. Where the page has a header action, the pin checks that the action is inside the header, drawn once, and still runs its handler: Audit Log's Refresh reloads the ledger, and Applications' New App opens the create-app route. The Settings namespace pin also checks that Back to settings is in the body and opens the hub, and that a manifest with no icon and no description draws neither. Each pin checks that the header is the body's previous sibling and sits outside the body's max-width.
- **CONTROL:** `DocsIndex.errorStateHeading-12553.test.tsx`. The docs portal's load-error h1 stays an h1, with no page header.
- **Ablation (one-time, on commit `f49d557319`).** AuditLogPage's old header was put back in place of `ConsolePageHeader` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `c7676b38b49f` to `f724e1e9dfb6`). Predicted: 3 of 3 Audit Log pins red. Observed: 3 of 3 red, `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="page-header"]`. The file was restored to blob == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty. The pin imports the page by relative path from `src/`, so no `dist/` sits on the path.
- **Union at HEAD `d40dd4c047`** (under the shared verify lock), 44 files: the nine new files, the inbox pin, every existing suite under `apps/console/src/pages/` that names a changed page, the suites elsewhere that name one (`AppContent.systemHubRoutes`, `orphanedPageComponentRefs-10520`, `StudioRoute.landingI18n`, `bootRedirectCoverage`, `notready-interpolation-6219`, `affordanceGrantMap-12082`, `dollar-dialect-alias-census`), and the census and ratchet suites that read console sources (`filterContextTokensSweep-10666`, `consoleToasterAnchor.ratchet-7482`, `expressionUser.mountSites.ratchet`, `ariaLabelLiteralCensus-12145`, `machineLocaleCensus-9909`, `ellipsis-glyph-3878`, `auth-namespace-3546`, `console-vite-alias-closure-4925`). Result: `Test Files 44 passed (44)`, `Tests 482 passed (482)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.

## Gates (local, at HEAD `d40dd4c047`; exit codes captured before any pipe)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`, after building the console's dependency closure (35 packages, VERDICT command-exit 0): exit 0. `tsc --listFilesOnly` shows all nine new test files in the program.
- `check:i18n-keys` 0 · `check:control-bytes` 0 · `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new citations) · `check:vi-mock-specifiers` 0 · `check:vi-mock-inherit` 0 · `check:vi-mock-override-shape` 0 · `check:test-path-roots` 0 · `check:unreferenced-sources` 0 · `check:changeset-claims` 0 · `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0.
- Changeset gates: `check-changeset-fixed` 0 · `check-changeset-no-major` 0 · `check-changeset-overwrite` 0 · `check-changeset-presence` 0.
- eslint over the 17 changed console files: exit 0, 0 errors. 37 warnings, none on a line this diff adds.
- `check:vi-mock-inherit` refused the first AI Approvals pin, whose hand-listed `plugin-chatbot` factory froze the module surface. Commit `d40dd4c047` makes it spread `importOriginal`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 18 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- CI runs the full farm. Known red, advisory: `Spec Main Shape Gate` (objectui#12464).

## What the landing seat's browser reading should show

At 1440 each page's header has the same height, title size and icon chip as the Leads list. Suggested three: Audit Log, Applications and a settings namespace page.

- **Flow Runs**, `/apps/APP/developer/flow-runs`: Workflow chip, "Flow Runs", subtitle beside it, no actions.
- **Integrations & APIs**, `/apps/APP/developer/integrations`: Plug chip, title, subtitle beside it, no actions.
- **Audit Log**, `/apps/APP/system/audit-log`: ScrollText chip, title, subtitle beside it, Refresh at the right.
- **AI Approvals**, `/apps/APP/system/ai-approvals`: no chip, title, and the two-sentence subtitle beside it, truncated where the row runs out.
- **Applications**, `/apps/APP/system/apps`: no chip, title, subtitle beside it, New App at the right.
- **Profile**, `/apps/APP/system/profile`, and the Account app's My Profile (`/apps/account/component/account/profile_card`): no chip, title and subtitle.
- **Settings**, `/apps/APP/system/settings`: Settings chip, title and subtitle, with the category sections below.
- **A settings namespace page**, for example `/apps/APP/system/settings/localization`: the manifest's icon in the chip, the title with its Beta badge when the manifest is beta, the description beside it, and Back to settings at the top of the body below the header.
- **Below `sm`** (390): one row of chip, title and actions on each page, with no subtitle.

## Acceptance notes

- A long subtitle (AI Approvals' is two sentences) is truncated by the one-row header where it does not fit, with no tooltip. That is the header's existing behaviour and is not changed here. No carrier; noted, not filed.
- On a beta settings page the heading's accessible name now includes the badge text (for example "Mail Beta"), as on an object list whose title carries a badge.
- The title typography moves from each page's own `text-2xl` bold to the header's `text-base` (`sm:text-lg`) semibold. That is the intended convergence.
- The census pathspec blind spot described above is where the card's page list and the claim's DocsIndex reading came from. A census over `apps/console/src/pages/` reads the whole directory.
- File surface: one test file beyond the claim's list, the DocsIndex control. It is test-only; `DocsIndex.tsx` itself is untouched.
